profile.headline: Software Engineer || 7 years of experience in React, Javascript, Node.js
profile.summary:
I’m a frontend-leaning full stack engineer with 7 years of experience building accessible, user-focused web apps. I work primarily with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js, and I’m passionate about creating tech that empowers marginalized communities. I love helping companies build meaningful connections with the people they serve.

I'm always open to connecting, especially if that includes talking about care, community and cats.

honors.title: 2nd Place Social Impact Firm - Be Your Own Boss Bowl
honors.description: In April 2013, PurpleTye competed against 8 other finalists for over $100,000 in cash and prizes from Temple University’s business plan competition, the Be Your Own Boss Bowl. Our business plan was reviewed by over 500 preliminary judges and then selected as finalist to present a 30 second pitch and 10 minute presentation to a host of judges. The competition was stiff, but PurpleTye managed to secure a 2nd place win in the social impact track and walk away with $5000 in startup funding, 6 months of business incubator space, business services, and Microsoft office products!
